findings.title: Bought Discourse as a Rival Route
findings.claim: The pericope turns the purchase of diverting speech into a bid for a rival route: 31:5 has just named guidance and success, and 31:7 shows the hearer turning from recited signs, so the bought words meet an already visible path and ridicule marks its abandonment as contemptible.
findings.mechanism: The focus's exchange word, spoken content, attention-capturing diversion, causative misdirection, path, and mockery meet the pericope's guidance and recitation sequence. That contact makes the purchase read as acquiring a steering instrument whose use redirects attention from the way shown in 31:5; mockery helps make the abandoned way seem unworthy of passage.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the verse joins buying, diversion, misdirection, and ridicule: acquired speech becomes a competing means of direction, and mockery makes turning away socially legible.
findings.containment: The ordinary claim remains that some people buy diverting talk to lead others from God's way and take it as mockery. The steering image is a pericope reading, not a claim that every purchased or entertaining utterance misleads or that the context proves a single causal sequence.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches and channel supports are supplied as trusted evidence. The 31:5 and 31:7 relations are connection nominations, so the steering synthesis is grounded in their supplied context while remaining an interpretive relation rather than a compelled causal account.

findings.title: Diversion as Fed and Spoken
findings.claim: With 31:7 bringing recitation and hearing into view, the focus's diversionary talk takes on a physical input/output image: لَهْوَ as grain placed in a mill mouth and as the uvula at the rear of a mouth meets حَدِيثِ as speech, so purchased diversion can be seen as material fed, formed, and sent into the same hearing space as recitation.
findings.mechanism: The mill-grain sense gives the diversion an input image, while the uvula sense gives it a physical passage for articulation. Spoken content in the focus and the following recitation/hearing scene supply independent utterance and reception contacts; their meeting changes diversion from an abstract label into something processed, issued, and heard.
findings.reader_payoff: The paired images give diversion material life: something introduced, formed, and received through the bodily channel of speech.
findings.containment: People still buy distracting talk to lead others away. Grain and anatomy are transferred images carried by supplied branch evidence; the text does not place literal grain or a body part in the scene, and the two senses are not all active in every use of لَهْوَ.

epistemic.reason: The branch glosses and candidate supports are trusted and the focus carriers are exact. The 31:7 connection supplies an adjacent auditory context without target morphology, so the input/output synthesis remains a bounded interpretation.
